Steps 1–2 are complete for batch 7. The full Alpha-facing report is in [research/frontier-19-batch-7.notes.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-batch-7.notes.md); the batch artifacts are [research/frontier-19-batch-7.pages.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-batch-7.pages.json), [research/frontier-19-batch-7.coverage.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-batch-7.coverage.json), and [research/frontier-19-batch-7.proof-contracts.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-batch-7.proof-contracts.json). I wrote `coverage.json` despite the dispatch’s later three-file list because the same dispatch and `QUALITY-CONTROLS.md` make the coverage harvest mandatory.

The scaffold is 21 A-page items and 11 B-page items. No split is needed, no forward references are kept, and there are no cross-batch dependencies: every load-bearing dep I kept is already `status: published` on disk. The main findings are:
1. MT-5 currently duplicates the cardinality-only measurable-not-Borel proof already owned by MT-4; the notes include exact old/new text keeping only the explicit witness route on MT-5.
2. The design and `plan-spec.json` disagree on `requires`; I scaffolded against the spec and recorded the drift instead of resolving it locally.
3. Bernstein existence needed an explicit “perfect set has cardinality continuum” theorem before the transfinite recursion; I added that scaffold.
4. The free-ultrafilter theorem is scaffolded through the local zero-one lemma plus complement involution only, never through Steinhaus.
5. The “nonmeasurable without stronger choice” false statement is kept, but explicitly as an external-dependent item via the published Solovay/Shelah remarks.

- `coverage-checklist`: clean, `1 page(s), 27 harvested result(s), 0 error(s), 0 warning(s)`.
- `source-fetch-check --stamp`: blocked by shell DNS failure, `EAI_AGAIN` on all 3 harvested URLs, so no fetch stamps were written.
- `proof-contract`: only the expected pre-authoring `item-missing` failures, because none of the scoped `items/*.md` files exist yet.
- `prosecheck`: `0 error(s), 10 warning(s)`, all `count-in-prose` in the required report language.
